description: Land Acquisition - Goviyapana, Habaraduwa D/S Division, Galle District and amendment to the Ex. Ord. Gaz. No. 1955/24 of 26.02.2016, Embilipitiya D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains notices for acquiring specific land parcels (including descriptions, claimants, and extents) and an amendment to a previous land acquisition declaration. The content is entirely focused on land/property matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
